additions.title: Bow Seat Blue Planet Awareness Contest 2027
additions.organisation: Bow Seat Creative Action for Conservation
additions.description: Create art, writing, film, performance or multimedia about environmental disinformation for the Nature of Truth theme. Entry is free. Submit online by 7 June 2027, 11:59pm Eastern Time. An adult sponsor is required; entrants under 13 need a parent or guardian consent form.
additions.eligibility: Middle and high school students aged 11-18 worldwide, including home-school students. Follow the category and consent rules.

additions.title: TSL International Student Competition 2027 - Navigating El Nino
additions.description: Share how world leaders should respond to worsening extreme weather through writing, art, audio or video. A teacher, parent or guardian submits through the official platform as a Teacher Champion. Entries close 1 March 2027; consult the official deadline time. Written entries have a 600-word limit and audio/video a three-minute limit.
additions.eligibility: Students aged 7-18 worldwide, in the 7-11 and 12-18 categories. Entries are coordinated by an adult Teacher Champion; home-school and independent students can participate.

additions.title: Sony World Photography Awards 2027 - Youth Competition
additions.description: Enter up to three photographs taken in 2026. Entry is free and closes 5 January 2027 at 16:00 GMT. Upload through the official photography account portal. The winner receives photography equipment and recognition, with a London awards ceremony included in the prize arrangements.
additions.eligibility: Open internationally to photographers aged 19 or younger on the closing date. Follow image ownership, size and originality rules; this listing is the Youth category.

additions.title: Sony World Photography Awards 2027 - Student Competition
additions.description: Submit a photographic series of 5-10 images responding to Journeys. Entry is free through the official account portal. Deadline: 27 November 2026. The page lists 16:00 GMT but a rules clause says 13:00 GMT, so submit before 13:00 GMT or confirm with the organiser. Your photography institution must be registered.
additions.eligibility: Photography students aged 18-30 worldwide at eligible World Photography Organisation institutions. Institutional registration and the image rules apply.

additions.title: Sister Cities Young Artists and Authors Showcase 2027
additions.description: Create one original work of art, photography, writing, poetry or music for A Tapestry of Cultures and the Threads That Connect Us. Submit digitally by 1 April 2027. Coordinate with your local Sister Cities programme first: its membership and approval are required, and local membership conditions or fees may apply.
additions.eligibility: Students aged 12-18 worldwide who are affiliated with a dues-paying Sister Cities International member or its international partner community, with a direct programme contact. Independent submission without programme approval is not eligible.

additions.title: Intellectaa iChallenge - Global Student Innovation Challenge 2026
additions.description: Submit an original research or build project using the organiser's 1,500-word template by 30 November 2026. Entry costs US$5, $10 or $20 plus applicable taxes depending on country income classification, payable through the link emailed after submission. Publication awards are subject to editorial review; other publication fees may apply.
additions.eligibility: School students in grades 8-12 or equivalent worldwide. Parent or guardian consent is required. One entry per student for this edition.

additions.title: Oxford Agora Global Essay and Defence Prize 2027
additions.description: Write an English essay on one of ten questions, then discuss your argument by video if shortlisted. Free registration and entry; essays close 31 January 2027 at 23:59 GMT. Junior essays allow 1,000 words and senior essays 1,500. The organiser is independent of Oxford and Cambridge universities. Any Oxford ceremony attendance is optional.
additions.eligibility: Students aged 11-18 on 31 January 2027 from any country or school system, including home-school students. Entrants under 18 need parent or guardian support. Junior cohort: 11-13; senior: 14-18.

payload.location: Online rounds; final in Wilmington, Delaware, United States
payload.description: Teams of two to four high school students develop an original business or social venture concept. Entries close 14 January 2027 at 5pm EST. Initial rounds offer virtual participation; finalists must send at least one team member to the in-person summit in Wilmington, Delaware, on 29-30 April 2027.
